'''2017 European Championship Day 3 Casper Jørgensen LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casper Jørgensen]] at [[2017 European Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Casper Jørgensen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125014231/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-european-championships/ Internet Archive]
